Description: Michi-note production platform in ap-northeast-3: private ECS Fargate, ALB/ACM/WAF, Multi-AZ RDS PostgreSQL, Cognito, S3/KMS, backup and monitoring.

DeploymentRegion.Description: Guard parameter. Deploy this stack in Asia Pacific (Osaka).

ContainerImage.Description: Immutable application image URI including a digest (recommended) or release tag.

DatabaseBootstrapMode.Description: Set enabled only for initial DB bootstrap; web desired/minimum task counts become zero until migration succeeds.

DatabaseEngineVersion.Description: PostgreSQL 16 minor version available in ap-northeast-3. Confirm availability before each deployment.

DomainName.Description: Public HTTPS host, for example app.example.jp.

HostedZoneId.Description: Route 53 public hosted zone that contains DomainName.

CognitoDomainPrefix.Description: Globally unique lower-case Cognito managed-login domain prefix.

CognitoCallbackUrl.Description: BFF OAuth callback, for example https://app.example.jp/auth/callback.

AlarmEmail.Description: Required operational alert address. The recipient must confirm the SNS subscription before production launch.

Assertions.AssertDescription: DeploymentRegion and the active AWS Region must both be ap-northeast-3.
TaskCpu and TaskMemory must be a supported AWS Fargate combination.
